summary: Lebanon experienced heightened military activity on October 28 with 119 alerts, 68 drone detections, four air strikes, and 30 artillery barrages across southern districts. CENTCOM denied Iranian claims of mine strikes in the Strait of Hormuz, confirming primary transit routes remain open. Iran's foreign minister declared armed forces fully prepared to defend the homeland amid observed UAV and jet activity in Isfahan and Fars provinces.
